name: FedoServerTools
author: Fedo
description: Server-only: reports connected players (with biome/armor/SteamID) and the current season (if Seasons is installed) to the Fedoheim API every ~30s so the launcher can show server status, lets an admin set the time of day/force a season/broadcast a message from the launcher, and kicks a connecting player whose character name is already linked to a different Fedoheim account. Only install on the actual dedicated server -- for the client-side companion (auto-connect, in-game clock), see FedoClientTools.
